what_it_is.prose: MTAR Technologies is a Hyderabad-based precision engineering company founded by P Ravindra Reddy in the 1970s, now led by next-generation management. Operates in 3 sectors: Space, Civilian Nuclear Power, and Defence & Aerospace. Over 30 years partnership with ISRO supplying mission-critical assemblies for GSLV and PSLV including Vikas engines and cryogenic upper-stage subsystems. Played crucial role in ISRO's 100th satellite launch (29 Jan 2025) and LVM3-M6 heaviest launch mission (Dec 2025) — supplying Vikas engines and cryogenic upper-stage subsystems. Civil nuclear: ₹563.23 Cr BHEL contract (Jun 2026); Nuclear Power Corporation of India order (Aug 2026); key supplier for Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor (PFBR). Defence: manufactured Agnikul Cosmos's rocket engines (Agnilet/Agnite).
